Look up a DOI for a parsed reference entry via Crossref

Source: R/bib-rand.R
rand_crossref_doi.Rd

Requires network access and the Suggests-only httr2 package. A candidate match is accepted only if its publication year is within one year of the entry's year and its title is at least min_sim similar (normalized Levenshtein similarity) – Crossref's bibliographic search is lenient, so check a sample of results by hand before trusting them in bulk.

Usage

rand_crossref_doi(r, mailto, min_sim = 0.85)

Arguments

r

A parsed entry, as from rand_parse_entry().

mailto

An email address to include in the request, per Crossref's "polite pool" convention.

min_sim

Minimum title similarity, in [0, 1].

Value

A DOI string, or NA_character_ if no match passed, or the entry's type isn't one Crossref can plausibly index (article, book, incollection).

Details

A candidate is also rejected if Crossref's own type for it doesn't match what's expected for r$type ("journal-article" for article, "book-chapter"/"chapter" for incollection, "monograph"/"book" for book). This matters most for books: Crossref indexes many book reviews whose title is just the book's own title, which would otherwise look like a near-perfect title match while actually being the wrong, unrelated work.
